Mathematics

The mission of Mathematical Sciences is to produce graduates who will: Develop mathematical ability and knowledge of the depth and breadth of mathematics. Communicate about mathematics and by utilizing mathematics. Use technology to support problem solving and promote understanding. Apply the mathematical sciences, including statistics, in other academic disciplines.

Why Study Mathematics at CSC?

Fully Online & Flexible

Earn your degree entirely online or in person—your choice. Perfect for working students or those unable to relocate.

Affordable Education

Pay the same flat tuition rate no matter where you live. Financial aid and scholarships available.

Career-Friendly Format

Keep your current job while advancing your education—no commuting or moving costs.

Choose question
Majors & Minors Offered

Majors offered:

  • Mathematics
  • Mathematics Education (Field Endorsement for Grades 6–12)
  • Mathematics (Grades 5–9 Middle Level Academic Area)

Minors available:

  • Mathematics
  • Applied Statistics
  • Mathematics Education (K–8)
How Blended Learning Works

All students get access to recorded lectures and Smart Board notes. On-campus students attend live classes, but distant students can follow along online with full access to materials.

Graduation Requirements

Students complete core requirements, one option (e.g., Education or Applied track), and general studies requirements.
Mathematics Education students complete Professional Education courses instead of a second major or minor.

Graduate Degrees Offered

Graduate degrees offered:

  • MAE in Mathematics
  • M.Ed. in Curriculum & Instruction (Math focus)

Haas Named 2026 NSCS Teaching Excellence Award Recipient

LINCOLN – The Board of Trustees of the Nebraska State Colleges has selected Assistant Professor Jordan Haas of Chadron State College as the 2026 Teaching Excellence Award recipient for the Nebraska State College System (NSCS). Haas was chosen during the Board’s April meeting and will be formally recognized during spring commencement ceremonies at Chadron State College.

Morgan named Dean

CHADRON – Dr. Ryan F. Morgan has been named Chadron State College’s Dean of Graduate Studies and the School of Business, Math, and Science, Vice President Jim Powell announced Monday. Dr. Morgan will begin his duties in July.
